name: Transparent Case Earbuds — Round Digit Display
description: True wireless earbuds in a see-through charging case with a round digit display window. Comes in lime green, black and pink.

source.notes: Cost unknown, owner set the price (₦7000). Checked against the store's crystal-display-true-wireless-earbuds (₦7,500, ¥13.5): same idea (see-through case with digits) but a different case (round dial window, wider, purple internal glow) and different buds, so a separate listing, not a duplicate. Pink and Black overlap in colour name only. Photos 1080-1200 px, clean on white, padded to 4:5, sharp. Display digits (88) are the supplier demo. Owner sent photos with no message; shop, listing, style name and ¥ price unknown. Likely the Shenzhen Huixun listing (offerId 1025659251706, 58.6% return rate) but unconfirmed: if so, samples first and stay unpublished. Lithium battery: sea freight only. No battery, playtime or waterproofing claimed.
